title: Run Filter Controller mechanical robustness QA
description: Create and run a reproducible WP-CLI harness for the non-visual portions of the Filter Controller robustness tests, then patch objective failures.
objective: Move robustness QA forward without pretending to complete Elementor visual/editor checks that belong to Guilherme.
expected_outputs: Sort-specific Style section gated by show_sort.
Filter runtime payload carries source, compare, and dataType when present.
FilterResolver supports explicit source/compare/dataType checks while preserving legacy type behavior.
Mechanical QA evidence note with passed and skipped-human-QA counts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness marks human visual/editor checks as skipped for Guilherme instead of passing them mechanically.
Registered meta date filters use the primary data value instead of mixed visible text.
Sort has an independent Style section that hides when Sort is disabled.
Existing manual key, dynamic tag binding, taxonomy, meta, and sort behavior continue to pass.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
WP-CLI robustness harness reports 49 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped_human_qa.

budgets.complexity_budget: complex but limited to mechanical checks and objective failures
budgets.context_budget: Filter Controller controls, settings, resolver, frontend payload, and Agentic Ops tests
budgets.research_budget: local code and local Elementor source only
budgets.validation_budget: lint, node syntax, composer, WP-CLI harness, Agentic Ops schemas

risks: Mechanical checks can miss visual hierarchy and editor-flow issues.
Adding compare semantics could alter existing filters if legacy empty compare fallback is not preserved.
Sort Style polish still needs Guilherme visual QA.
